name: Sable Fix Core 1.4.0
body:
## v1.4.0 — Audit Marathon 🔍

A full overnight audit marathon across **8 audit passes** (scan pipeline, GUI render, command handlers, final-coverage, compatibility matrix, fuzz inputs, regression self-check, usability walkthrough): 29 fixes and improvements, every one build-verified with jshell behavioral assertions.

### ⚡ Performance
- **All main-thread disk scans eliminated**: startup check, panel data, `/sablefix check`, `list`, `repair-all`, even tab-completion now run on a dedicated background scan pool — a 600-file archive no longer freezes the server for ~3.5s per command.
- Sublevel scan reads 7.3× faster (sorted batched segments vs per-pointer syscalls): 9.6 GB archive ≈ 3.5 s instead of 26 s.
- GUI render hot-path: cached lang lookups (was ~50 translatable constructions per frame at 60fps), cached browse sort/filter, precomputed ticket aggregation and statistics, row backgrounds direct-filled.

### 🛡️ Robustness (fuzz-verified)
- NBT depth-bomb: a 52-byte gzip could hang the startup scan forever — now rejected as corrupt.
- NBT int-overflow: fabricated UUIDs from arbitrary bytes → false damage registration → players were induced to purge healthy tickets — now long-arithmetic guarded.
- gzip decompression capped at 64 MB (bomb protection); negative NBT lengths rejected.
- Truncated files (<4096B) now fail explicitly in `dry` (was: check said broken, repair said nothing-to-fix → warning loop forever).
- Negative VarInt in network packets no longer kicks the client.
- Segment reads retry on short reads (was: healthy pointers misjudged dead → players could clear good records).

### 🔧 Correctness & UX
- Log truncation kept the **newest** entries (was dropping exactly the 50 most recent — the ones you needed).
- Panel close releases its static reference (was: object leak + packets delivered to closed UI).
- GUI repair/purge now clears the damage ledger (was: kept warning about already-fixed files).
- Windows read-shared file locks now show the actionable "stop server first" hint (was: raw error).
- Non-OP players get one summary line on join (was: N identical messages).
- `/sablefix help` lists all commands incl. `diag`; tab-completion warms its cache for command-only users.
- Thread dumps capped at 50 files; SaveObserver pending-tracking leak fixed; case-insensitive file fallback iteration fixed.

### 🌐 Protocol
- **v3** — both sides must run 1.4.0 together (mismatch rejected at handshake with a clear message).

## 中文

一夜 8 轮审计、29 项修复改进，每项 build + jshell 行为断言双重验证。

- ⚡ **主线程零磁盘扫描**：启动体检/面板/命令/补全全部后台化；子层级扫描 7.3× 提速（9.6GB 存档 26s→3.5s）；GUI 每帧翻译/排序/聚合全部缓存预计算
- 🛡️ **模糊输入加固**：52 字节 gzip 深度炸弹不再挂死启动（原可永久卡死）；NBT 溢出不再伪造 UUID 误导清理；64MB 解压上限；负长度拒收；截断文件明确报"不可修复"（原提示死循环）；短读补全防误判
- 🔧 **正确性**：日志截断改保留最新（原恰好丢最新 50 条）；面板关闭释放引用；GUI 修复/清理同步清登记簿；Windows 句柄占用给出"停服后操作"提示；非 OP 进服一条汇总；help 补全 diag；dump 保留 50 份上限
- 🌐 **协议 v3** —— 双端必须同升 1.4.0（握手期明确拒绝）
